svg.title: How a tap finds its Autodarts tab
svg.desc: A tap on a player goes to the Autodarts tab shown in the window used last, then to a tab shown in another window, then to the tab shown most recently. When no tab answers, the extension reloads the tab in front, or opens Autodarts behind the popup when no tab is open, and waits until the page has renewed the session it started with. Then it switches there, and every other Autodarts tab reloads with the new player.
